name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Between Birchpool and Mossbank, one goes with Leech and the other with Minnow.
Between Royce and Birchpool, one goes with Dough and the other with Minnow.
If Leech goes with Mossbank, then Esther goes with Cricket.
Corn goes with at least one of Esther or Cedarmere.
Pinehollow goes with none of Esther, Mabel, or Cricket.
If Birchpool does not go with Mabel, then Leech goes with Esther.
Both Dough goes with Pinehollow and Minnow does not go with Mabel if and only if Cedarmere goes with Cody.
